AUC of the Frequency dimension computed with different half-lives. Back-test: as-of 2025-01-01 vs self-activity 2025H1; forward: scored as of 4 Jun 2025 vs sales-call outcomes.

Same five dimensions, different weights. Black = our weights. "Drop X" = remove one dimension and re-normalise. Machine-learned weights = logistic regression on each outcome (forward one is in-sample).
Scored as of 4 Jun 2025. Coverage = share of customers with a real (non-default) value; overlap = Spearman correlation with Frequency; AUC forward = positive sales-call outcome after the snapshot.
Outcome rate per ES decile. Back-test: ES as-of 2025-01-01, existing customers; forward: ES scored as of 4 Jun 2025, per-call rates after the snapshot.
ES rebuilt with only data available at each date (no call/app data); outcome = self-initiated activity in the following 150 days; existing customers.

Lines = engagement level at the scoring date. Left: self-initiated activity per 30-day month after 2025-01-01 (existing customers). Right: per-call positive rate per 30-day month after 4 Jun 2025 (CALL dates are an association only, see §7.1b).
Multivariable logistic regression, odds ratios with 95% CI. Back-test: existing customers, ES/FHS as-of 2025-01-01; forward: customers called after 4 Jun 2025.
Existing customers at both dates; rows sum to 100%. Same ES definition at both dates (no call/app data).
Scored as of 4 Jun 2025. Rows = FHS tier, columns = ES band; colour = segment (split cells show the risk guard-rails D16), small text = main sub-segment kept in the output file.
Customers on the FHS × ES plane (60k random sample) and segment sizes at the snapshot.
Outcome rates per segment. Back-test: segments built as-of 2025-01-01; forward: segments scored as of 4 Jun 2025 vs calls until 2026-08.
Share of customers per recommended action (scored as of 4 Jun 2025). Triggers override the segment action in the order T1 → T2 → T3.
Cumulative gains of positive sales-call outcomes after 4 Jun 2025 when customers are ranked by their ES at the snapshot.
Forward window (4 Jun 2025 → Aug 2026): distribution of outbound sales-call attempts and their productivity per segment.
Bubble size = customers. Dotted lines = average risk / response. Risk: back-test as-of 2025-01-01; response: forward calls 2025-06 → 2026-08.
True conversion = a loan booked within 30 days of lead creation (LEADS joined to CONTRACT). PULL = GMA/Landing page/SOB; WARM = TLS/RTDM; PUSH = RA/SA.
Applications 2023-03 → 2025-06; channels = APP, WEB, SA, TLS, Partner site, Store (PAST_BEHAVIOR) in the 90 days before applying.
Share of customers booking a new loan between 2025-01-01 and 2025-06-04, by position in their instalment-loan life-cycle on 2025-01-01. Maturity = start + tenor × 30.44 days.
Outbound sales calls 2025-01 → 2026-08 (collection & service calls excluded). Connected = talk-time > 0 or system ANSWER.
